shortlist.label: Melanonychia
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive pigmented nail lesion with nail thickening

shortlist.label: Onychomatricoma
shortlist.why_kept: Bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix

shortlist.label: Nail matrix nevus
shortlist.why_kept: Pigmented lesion with corresponding nail thickening

shortlist.label: Subungual hematoma
shortlist.why_kept: Intracorneal hemorrhage and adjacent verrucous hyperkeratosis present

shortlist.label: Onychocytic matricoma
shortlist.why_kept: Villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation

raw.rationale: The histopathologic examination showing bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium and villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia is consistent with onychomatricoma, a rare benign tumor of the nail matrix.

rejected.label: Melanonychia
rejected.why: No melanocytic lesions were observed on histopathologic examination

rejected.label: Nail matrix nevus
rejected.why: Immunostaining was negative for S100, which is typically positive in melanocytic lesions

rejected.label: Subungual hematoma
rejected.why: The presence of a progressively growing lesion and nail thickening is not typical of a subungual hematoma, which is usually a result of trauma

rejected.label: Onychocytic matricoma
rejected.why: The histopathologic findings do not match the typical features of onychocytic matricoma
